name: My Christmas Advent Calendar for WooCommerce
author: Long Watch Studio - Code Faeries

sections.description:
My Christmas Advent Calendar adds an advent calendar to your WooCommerce shop. Every box has an opening date and a reward. On that day, each customer can open the box once and see the reward in a dialog. You choose whether customers log in to open boxes, or give an e-mail address once and open boxes without an account.

A Christmas calendar gives your customers a reason to come back to your shop every day of December: a discount code one day, free shipping the next, a kind word or a gift idea in between. The calendar is ready on activation, with 24 boxes to fill and a page to publish.

For your customers

  • A grid of boxes, shown on any page with the [codefaeries_advent_calendar] shortcode or the “Advent Calendar” block.
  • The calendar opens in a Christmas scene, with doors that swing open, falling snow and confetti. If you prefer, it takes the style of your site instead.
  • Four box states: locked, open today, opened, and missed for a past day left unopened.
  • In your site’s style, today’s box takes the look of your theme’s main shop button, the other boxes a quiet surface drawn from your text color.
  • One opening per box and per customer, checked again by the server.
  • A line under the grid says when the next box opens.
  • A short door opening effect, skipped for visitors who asked for reduced motion.
  • Coupon rewards come with an “Apply to cart” button.
  • Visitors can open boxes without an account: they type an e-mail address once, then open one box a day. A logged-in customer has nothing to type. If you prefer, require a login instead, and visitors then see the grid and a link to log in or create an account.
  • A visitor who later logs in or creates an account keeps the boxes already opened.

For you

  • 24 boxes dated December 1 to 24 are created on activation, each with a demo reward flagged until you replace it.
  • A draft page holding the shortcode is created for you to review and publish.
  • Set the opening date, label and reward of each box, and add or delete boxes.
  • Reward a box with a text, or with a WooCommerce coupon you pick from your published coupons. Amount, validity and usage limits stay set in WooCommerce.
  • A coupon won in a box is refused to customers who did not open that box. A visitor who won it can use it at checkout without an account, on the same browser, or after entering the same address on the calendar again.
  • Choose who can open boxes in the Settings tab: customers who are logged in, or visitors who give an e-mail address. The e-mail address is not verified.
  • Choose what happens to a box nobody opened on its day: closed for good, or still openable later.
  • Choose the look in the Appearance tab: the Christmas tradition scene, or your site’s style, where the calendar inherits the fonts, colors and buttons of your theme. In the Christmas scene, the color of the doors and buttons can be changed.
  • Put shortcodes and YouTube or Vimeo videos in the reward text of a box.
  • Show a message on a locked box, with the opening date of the box in it.
  • Preview the calendar page on any date from the Boxes tab, as the shop admin. Opening a box in the preview records nothing.
  • Start a new season with “Move every date one year later” in the Boxes tab.

My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro

This plugin is complete on its own. My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro is a separate plugin for shops that want a calendar with its own look and more rewards:

  • Three more ready-made themes, Night village, Scandinavian workshop and Candy cane, each with its scene, colors, title and opening style.
  • Four more ways a box opens, besides the door of the Christmas tradition look: shutters swung aside, an envelope with its card out, a gift box without its lid, or a check mark. An opened box shows what it held.
  • A box can offer a product: opening it puts the product in the cart, free.
  • The customer’s streak of boxes opened day after day, as a number and a row of dots.
  • Statistics: unique customers, openings, average openings per customer, longest and shortest streak.
  • A live preview of the calendar on any day of December before you apply a change.
  • A door text, a door color, a text color and an image for each box.
  • Boxes of varied sizes, in date order or shuffled.
  • Several calendars, prepared in advance, from New Year, Valentine’s Day, Easter and Halloween templates, with statistics for each.
  • With WooRewards, Virtual Wallet and VIP Memberships: points, wallet credit or a membership given by a box.

The Pro includes this plugin and keeps the boxes and openings already recorded.

Your data stays on your site

My Christmas Advent Calendar calls no third-party service and loads nothing from another server, with one exception: videos.

A YouTube or Vimeo video you place in a box loads that service’s player for the visitor who opens the box. Saving a reward with a video address also makes your site ask that video service for its player, once.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress “Plugins” screen, or upload it to the /wp-content/plugins/lws-advent-calendar directory.
  2. Activate it. WooCommerce must be active.
  3. Go to WooCommerce > My Christmas Advent Calendar to set your boxes, then publish the “Advent Calendar” draft page.
sections.faq:
Where does the calendar show?

On any page holding the [codefaeries_advent_calendar] shortcode or the “Advent Calendar” block of the block editor, which shows what the shortcode shows. On activation the plugin creates a draft page named “Advent Calendar” with the shortcode in it: review it, publish it, and link to it from your menu or your newsletter.

Can customers see a reward before its day?

No. The reward of a box is sent to the page only once the customer has opened that box, so reading the page source reveals nothing about the days to come.

When does a box open?

On its opening date, in the time zone of your site (Settings > General).

What happens to a box nobody opened on its day?

By default it shows as missed and stays closed for good. See “Can a box be opened after its day?” below to change that.

Can a box be opened after its day?

Yes, if you choose so. In the Settings tab, “Late boxes” is either “closed for good” (the default) or “can still be opened later”: a box nobody opened on its day then stays openable, and each customer still opens each box once. Boxes of days to come stay closed in both cases.

Is it only for December 1 to 24?

No. The 24 December boxes are a starting point: you can change the date of each box, add boxes and delete boxes.

Can customers open a box without an account?

Yes. In the Settings tab, “Who can open boxes” has two choices:

  • “Customers must be logged in to open boxes.”: visitors see the grid and a link to log in or create an account. Sites that update from an earlier version keep this choice until you change it.
  • “Visitors open boxes by giving an e-mail address, no account needed.”: a visitor types an e-mail address once, then opens one box a day without an account. A logged-in customer has nothing to type. A new installation starts with this choice.

The e-mail address is not verified by an e-mail: someone can type an address that is not theirs. Boxes opened as a visitor follow the visitor when they log in or create an account.

What data does the calendar store about a visitor?

When boxes open by e-mail address: the address, the boxes opened and when, a keyed hash of the IP address (the address itself is not stored), used to limit abuse, and a cookie holding a signed identifier for 60 days. A visitor’s openings are linked to the account they later log in to or create. For a logged-in customer, the plugin stores which boxes the account opened and when. Nothing is sent to a third party. The data appears in the WordPress export and erase personal data tools, a suggested text is added to your privacy policy page, and everything is removed when you delete the plugin.

Can I put a shortcode or a video in a reward?

Yes. The text reward of a box accepts shortcodes and videos from YouTube (youtube.com and youtube-nocookie.com) and Vimeo, which load that service’s player when the customer opens the box. A shortcode that needs scripts loaded with the page may not work in the reward window, and shortcode output that uses forms or scripts is removed from it.

Can I tell customers when a locked box opens?

Yes. In the Settings tab, “Message on a locked box” is shown on a box that is still locked, and {date} in it is replaced by the opening date of the box. A new installation starts with “Come back on {date}.” A site that updates shows no message until you save the setting.

How do I start a new season?

In the Boxes tab, “Move every date one year later” moves the date of every box one year on, so the same calendar serves next December. It deletes every opening after a confirmation: coupons won in a box are then refused at checkout, and the statistics start again.

Does My Christmas Advent Calendar create coupons?

No. You create your coupons in WooCommerce, then pick one for each coupon box.

Can a coupon from the calendar be shared?

A coupon won in a box is refused at checkout to customers who did not open that box, whoever gave them the code.

What does My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro add?

Three more themes, four more ways a box opens, a free product as a reward, the customer’s streak, statistics, a live preview, and points, wallet credit or memberships with the other Long Watch Studio plugins. See the “My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro” section of the description.

What happens to my data when I delete the plugin?

Deleting the plugin removes its settings, its boxes, its openings and the e-mail addresses of visitors. The calendar page is removed only if it is still the untouched draft created on activation. While My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro is active, it keeps using them: deleting this plugin then removes nothing.
sections.changelog:
0.7.0

The boxes are stored by calendar, ready for several calendars.

  • Improved: the boxes are now stored by calendar, ready for the several calendars of My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro. Your calendar, its openings and its coupons are kept as they are.
  • New: the block can show another calendar when My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro is active.

0.6.0

Richer rewards, a message on locked boxes and tools to preview and renew the calendar.

  • New: shortcodes and YouTube or Vimeo videos in the reward text of a box. A reward saved before this version keeps its display until you save its box again.
  • New: a “Message on a locked box” setting, where {date} becomes the opening date of the box. A new installation starts with “Come back on {date}.”
  • New: a dated preview of the calendar page for the shop admin, from the Boxes tab. Opening a box in the preview records nothing.
  • New: “Move every date one year later” in the Boxes tab, to start a new season. It deletes every opening after a confirmation.

0.5.0

The Christmas tradition look comes to this plugin.

  • New: an Appearance tab to choose how the calendar looks: the Christmas tradition scene, with doors that swing open, falling snow and confetti, or your site’s style.
  • New: the color of the doors and buttons of the Christmas scene can be changed.
  • New: a new installation starts with the Christmas tradition look. Sites that update keep their current look until you change it in the Appearance tab.

0.4.0

Visitors can open boxes without an account.

  • New: “Who can open boxes” setting: by account, or by e-mail address. In e-mail mode a visitor types an address once, then opens one box a day; a logged-in customer has nothing to type. The address is not verified.
  • New: sites that update keep opening by account until you change the setting; a new installation starts with the e-mail address.
  • New: “Late boxes” setting: a box nobody opened on its day stays closed for good, as before, or can still be opened later.
  • New: an “Advent Calendar” block for the block editor, showing what the shortcode shows.
  • New: a line under the grid says when the next box opens.
  • New: a coupon won by a visitor is accepted at checkout without an account, and boxes opened as a visitor follow the visitor when they log in or create an account.
  • New: personal data of visitors in the WordPress export and erase tools, a suggested text for your privacy policy, and removal of everything when the plugin is deleted.

0.3.1

No change in this plugin: its version number follows My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro 0.3.1.

0.3.0

No change in this plugin: its version number follows My Christmas Advent Calendar Pro 0.3.0.

0.2.1

An advent calendar for WooCommerce: dated boxes, one opening per logged-in customer, text and coupon rewards.

  • New: calendar grid shown with the [codefaeries_advent_calendar] shortcode, with locked, open today, opened and missed boxes.
  • New: today’s box takes your theme’s main shop button, the other boxes a quiet surface drawn from your text color.
  • New: on a phone, the grid keeps three columns.
  • New: one opening per box and per customer, with a door opening effect.
  • New: text rewards, and coupon rewards with an “Apply to cart” button in your theme’s main button style.
  • New: coupons won in a box are refused to customers who did not open it.
  • New: 24 demo boxes and a draft calendar page created on activation.
  • New: box settings screen under WooCommerce, with the coupon picked from your published coupons.
  • New: clean removal of settings, boxes and openings when the plugin is deleted.
